core_obligations: Choose the affine charts and produce a quasi-finite map R[x_1, ..., x_d] -> A after a principal localization, then translate the statement into the algebra equivalence of (a), (b) and (c) (proof lines 6786-6814).
Assume the polynomial algebra map flat and spread the data out to a Noetherian R using the base change behaviour of the Gorenstein locus (proof lines 6816-6828).
In the Noetherian affine case with the factorization X -> A^n_S -> S, compute f^!O_S through the shriek of the affine line and apply the Noetherian Gorenstein lemma (proof lines 6830-6841).
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction and existence of one quasi-finite map (proof lines 6786-6798).
Translation into the algebra problem (proof lines 6800-6814).
Flatness, spreading out and reduction to Noetherian (proof lines 6816-6828).
The shriek computation and conclusion (proof lines 6830-6841).
difficulty_reason: For a flat locally finite presentation f : X -> S, a point x with image s and d = dim_x(X_s), the lemma shows the equivalence of four conditions: f is Gorenstein at x; there is an open U containing x with a locally quasi-finite morphism U -> A^d_S over S that is Gorenstein at x; the same with U -> A^d_S globally Gorenstein; and for every S-morphism g : U -> A^d_S from an open neighbourhood of x, quasi-finiteness of g at x implies that g is Gorenstein at x; in particular the Gorenstein locus is open (statement lines 6767-6784). The proof reduces to algebra: it chooses affine U = Spec(A) and V = Spec(R) with R -> A flat of finite presentation, replaces A by a principal localization so that a quasi-finite map R[x_1, ..., x_d] -> A exists by Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-quasi-finite-over-polynomial-algebra, thus producing at least one pair (U, g) (proof lines 6786-6798). The statement is then translated, with the translation marked 'omitted', into the equivalence of (a) Spec(phi) Gorenstein at p, (b) Spec(A) -> Spec(R) Gorenstein at p and (c) the same in an open neighbourhood of p (proof lines 6800-6814). Since flatness is open by Algebra, Theorem labelled algebra-theorem-openness-flatness, one may assume R[x_1, ..., x_n] -> A flat, and Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat produces R_0 of finite type over Z and R_0[x_1, ..., x_n] -> A_0 of finite type and flat spreading out the data; because the Gorenstein locus of a flat finite type morphism commutes with base change by Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-gorenstein, this reduces to Noetherian R (proof lines 6816-6828). Finally, with X and S affine and a factorization X -> A^n_S -> S with g flat quasi-finite and S Noetherian, the proof writes f^!O_S = g^!p^!O_S = g^!O_{A^n_S}[n] using Lemmas labelled lemma-upper-shriek-composition and lemma-shriek-affine-line, and concludes the equivalence of (a), (b) and (c) from Lemma labelled lemma-affine-flat-Noetherian-gorenstein (proof lines 6830-6841). Translating the geometric conditions into the algebra problem and then spreading out to the Noetherian case, with the shriek computation providing the link, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
